description: Create a new task list. A task list is the container tasks live in — use this when a workflow needs its own list rather than adding to '@default'.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

title.description: Title of the new task list, as it appears in the Tasks UI

name: gws-mcp__tasks_create_tasklist
